assumptions: CLI route `--metric iwssim` -> in-tree crates/iwssim native SIMD port (metrics/mod.rs:419-438); default path is Iwssim::score (pipeline.rs:135-157) -> score_gray_internal -> score_from_gray (pipeline.rs:546-563): cold path, no warm-reference reuse, no strip mode, no diffmap sink.

Luma: YiqUnrounded = 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B unrounded f32 (lib.rs:236-241) — piq rgb2yiq channel 0, the AIC-4 IW-SSIM column convention (metrics/mod.rs:429-438). No rounding: 3 cvt + 3 mul + 2 add. Only difference vs iwssim (Bt601Rounded adds round_half_to_even).

Inputs with min(W,H) >= MIN_NATIVE_DIM=176 run natively (lib.rs:111); pad_gray_into is then a plain memcpy (pipeline.rs:516-537) -> counted as implementation-class copy. Smaller inputs are REJECTED by default (allow_small=false); the tiled-pad path is out of scope.

Laplacian pyramid (pyramid.rs:225-269): S=5 fixed levels; per level: corr_dn_h + corr_dn_v (binom5 5-tap, reflect1, stride-2, simd_kernels.rs corr_dn_h/v) then up_conv_h + up_conv_v expand of G[l+1] and lp[l] = g - expanded. dims halve via ceil.

corr_dn_h computes the correlation at ALL in_w positions into corr_row then decimates (simd_kernels.rs:1170-1204): the odd-position work (~5 fma + scratch traffic per output) is unused materialized intermediate -> implementation-class stage gauss_h_waste.

cs_stats (ssim.rs:81-139): 11x11 Gaussian VALID-mode per scale -> cs dims (w_l-10)x(h_l-10). Per cs element (amortized): 5 planes x (11 fma h + 11 fma v) = 110 fma; 3 fused product h-passes ~3 mul; cs_combine = 5 mul + 5 add + 1 rcp + 2 cmp (sigma clamps). Luminance multiply only at top scale (separate cs_lum stage).

IW maps (weights.rs:302-418), scales s=0..3: fused 3x3 box stats+gain (box_gain_rows) over the full 'same' plane; parent band = imenlarge2(lp[s+1]) for s<3; Gram accumulate upper-triangle 55 f64 fma/px (big_n=10; s=3 is parentless big_n=9 -> counted at 10, ~10% overcount there); eig decompose+invert is a constant ~6k-flop 10x10 Jacobi per scale (eig.rs:49+); quad_form_rows = big_n^2+big_n = 110 fma + 1 div per px; infow = per-px (vv+(1+g^2)s2)ss*lam_k+... summed over big_n lambdas with log2 (simd_kernels.rs:1522-1579).
Pooling: scales 0..3 weighted_sum_pair_iw_strided (fma+add per cs el); top scale plain mean; final score = prod |wmcs_s|^beta_s (5 pow) constant stage.
powf/log2 library calls counted as one op of their class; fma=2 flops in evaluator. bytes_* = compulsory plane traffic; stencil taps in load.

halo: pyramid corr_dn chains per level (radius 2, scale 2^l, axis-split h/v merged into xy since both axes filtered); expand reads the coarse grid (radius 1, scale 2^(l+1)); cs window radius 5 at scale 2^l (valid-mode: receptive field, not edge halo).

stages.name: sRGB8 -> YIQ luma f32 (unrounded)
stages.notes: 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B, no rounding (piq convention).

stages.name: gray -> work-size scratch (memcpy when >=176)
stages.notes: sw==work_w at all default eval shapes -> copy_from_slice only.

stages.name: binom5 reduce: horizontal correlate + decimate
stages.notes: corr_dn_h writes scratch = h_cur*w_nxt, a FULL intermediate plane (pyramid.rs:272-276,579-583) - each output row correlates full-width into corr_row then keeps even cols (waste in gauss_h_waste).

stages.name: binom5 reduce: vertical pass
stages.notes: corr_dn_v over the scratch plane emits the decimated level (full).

stages.name: corr_dn_h odd-position overcompute + corr_row scratch + decimate
stages.notes: Full-width correlate + decimate: 1 unused corr el per output (5 fma + 5 ld + ~2 corr_row st) + decimate gather (1 ld + 1 st).

stages.name: LP expand: horizontal upconv
stages.notes: h-pass: ~N_l/2 elements (half-height rows, full upsampled width); parity-split taps avg 2.5 fma; writes the row-expanded intermediate plane.

stages.name: LP expand: vertical upconv
stages.notes: v-pass writes the full expanded plane read by lp_sub.

stages.name: lp[l] = g[l] - expanded[l]
stages.notes: Coarsest level's lp IS the Gaussian residual (no subtract) -> counted anyway, ~1/256 overcount.

stages.name: cs stats: 11-tap horizontal pass on 5 planes
stages.notes: h-pass on (w_l-10) x h_l per plane writes h_scratch = h*cs_w, a full intermediate plane (ssim.rs:94-127); the 3 product muls fuse into its input gather (ssim_gauss_product_h_pass).

stages.name: cs stats: vertical pass + combine
stages.notes: v-pass over the 5 intermediates (valid window h_l-10) + combine (5mul 5add rcp 2cmp) writing the 6 stat planes.

stages.name: top-scale luminance multiply l*cs
stages.notes: l = (2 m1 m2 + C1)/(m1^2+m2^2+C1) fused into cs_combine at s=4 only; in-place (no extra traffic).

stages.name: fused 3x3 box stats + gain correction -> g, vv (same-pad)
stages.notes: Per el: 9 taps x (2 ld + 2 add + 3 fma) then gain: 8 mul + 4 add + div + fma + 4 cmp + 2 st. Reads lp_ref+lp_dis.

stages.name: imenlarge2 lp[s+1] -> parent band (s<3)
stages.notes: Fused bilinear t1 cells: v0+wx(v1-v0) twice + wy lerp -> 3 fma + 2 sub per out el; borders/corners negligible; crop to (w_l,h_l).

stages.name: Gram accumulate upper-triangle big_n^2 f64 over valid region
stages.notes: 55 mul+add pairs per px (big_n=10; s=3 is 45 - counted at parent-ful). Taps read lp_ref stencil + parent band. Global Gram per scale.

stages.name: C_u = Gram/nexp; Jacobi eig + PSD clean + invert 10x10
stages.notes: Constant per scale: ~45 Jacobi rotations x ~5 sweeps (rot ~ 4 trig-class + 2n row ops each side) + 10x10 invert ~ n^3/3 + mirror/normalize ~200 ops. Rough constant estimate.

stages.name: ss = (Y C_inv) . Y / N dense stencil per px
stages.notes: inner big_n^2=100 fma + outer big_n=10 fma + /N div; 9 taps + parent load.

stages.name: infow = sum_k log2(1 + ((vv+(1+g^2)s2)ss lam_k + s2 vv)/s4)
stages.notes: Per px: opg fma + (vv+opg*s2)*ss fma+mul + s2*vv mul; lambda loop (10 for s<3, 9 at s=3): fma+mul+add+log2 each; tol clamp cmp+blend.

stages.name: weighted_sum_pair_iw_strided per scale (cs.iw crop)
stages.notes: Per cs el: cs*iw fma + iw add + strided iw gather + cs load; per-scale div + cvt to f64 amortized to ~0.

stages.name: top-scale plain mean of cs
stages.notes: sum += v as f64 per element; one div at end.

stages.name: score = prod_s |wmcs_s|^beta_s
stages.notes: SCALE_WEIGHTS beta = {0.0448, 0.2856, 0.3001, 0.2363, 0.1333} applied as f64 powf.
